title: Race
description: A race/ancestry. Races relate to one another in two distinct ways. (1) PARENT → SUBRACE is inheritance: a subrace descends from a parent race (green/black elves from elf, hill/mountain dwarves from dwarf) and an engine layers the subrace on top of the parent's defaults. (2) TEMPLATE → KIN is sister conformance, NOT inheritance: a template (e.g. beastman) defines only the shape; its kin (catman, wolfman, …) each define everything themselves and need share nothing. Parent and template entries are abstract scaffolding and are not played directly; standalone races, subraces, and kin are playable.

lineage.description: How this race relates to others.

role.description: standalone: a complete, unrelated race (human). parent: an abstract ancestor that subraces inherit from (elf, dwarf). subrace: descends from and extends a parent via `parent_race` (inherits its defaults, overrides freely). template: an abstract shape for sister races (beastman) — provides structure, not values. kin: a sister race conforming to a template via `parent_race`, sharing nothing mechanical with its siblings.

parent_race.description: Reference to the parent race when role=subrace, or the template when role=kin. Use namespaced format core:race/<key>.

key.description: Symbolic snake_case key (the old string id) for human readability when editing JSON.

label.description: Human-readable display name with spaces and capitalization.

phase.description: The race's innate element (Wuxing five-phase). Optional tag for playable races (standalone, parent, subrace, kin); omitted on templates, whose kin each declare their own. A subrace may inherit its parent's phase or override it. Drives elemental affinity via the cycles in data/wuxing.

ability_modifiers.description: Attribute modifiers, keyed by attribute id (e.g. { "end": 2, "agi": -1 }). On a subrace these stack on top of the parent's (engine-resolved).

speed.description: Walking speed: one move action covers floor(speed / speed_divisor) squares, speed_divisor from the move row of actions/core.json (docs/core/actions.md#how-far-a-move-goes, docs/core/contract.md#distance)

traits.description: Racial traits granted by this race entry. Each item references a feature of type `racial_trait` in the perk table (data/features) by namespaced ref, and nothing else: the trait's label lives in the feature row (docs/core/integrity.md#8-a-reference-is-the-key-alone). For parent races these are the base traits; for subraces they stack on the parent's; kin list all of their own.

id.description: Reference to a racial_trait feature. Use namespaced format core:feature/<key> (or a module: ref).

allOf.description: Self-contained races (standalone/parent/kin) must declare speed and size; subraces may inherit them from the parent, templates omit them.
